messages:
Ivy (AM): Heads-up: Solaris Therapeutics wants to add 3 new feature teams next month (search QA, analytics, and content generation). They also asked about enabling reranker + embeddings for an internal tool. Getting a steady increase in nightly embedding jobs — up ~3x over baseline.

Nina (CSM): Thanks. Do they have any compliance/VPC asks or is this purely hosted?

Ivy (AM): Right now hosted, but they mentioned exploring Private for data locality later in quarter. Could be renewal conversation.

Ravi (Solutions): For onboarding multiple teams we usually suggest a hybrid approach: staging Dedicated pilot for the heavy embedding pipelines + hosted for low-latency rerankers. Will draft a proposal.

Kai (EngOncall): Can you share recent token and request patterns? I want to check if current plan will sustain 3x.

Ivy (AM): Quick numbers: 01:00-05:00 nightly batches p50=140 req/s p95=480 req/s, current sustained window ~2hrs. Link to sample logs: https://redwood.example/logs/solaris/embeddings-2026-03-01

Nina (CSM): I'll confirm whether the teams will run simultaneous nightly runs or staggered windows. If simultaneous, we should recommend slotting.

Ravi (Solutions): Also recommend enabling prefix caching and advising them to switch from full-index rebuilds to incremental embeddings to reduce load. I'll put together runbook and cost delta.

Kai (EngOncall): Temporary mitigation: enabling KV cache and limiting job concurrency to 6 per-team reduces observed peak by ~35% in tests. Opening quota change request to allow short-term 2x burst while we plan Dedicated pilot.

QuotaBot: Ticket created F-20260315-09. customer=SolarisTherapeutics, multiplier=2, reason="multi-team onboarding + nightly embedding spike". Status=PENDING_APPROVAL.

Harper (Infra): I've been pinged. Will review the ticket and run quick capacity check. Expect reply in 6 hours.

Ivy (AM): This looks like a solid expansion signal (new teams + Private interest). Action items: Nina confirm cadence, Ravi proposal & cost, Kai temp quota + runbook, Harper approve/deny ticket. I'll prepare AE brief for renewal outreach.

Nina (CSM): Adding to Gainsight as "expansion opportunity" and scheduling an enablement workshop for next Tue 30m.

Ravi (Solutions): Drafting proposal now, will share in this thread when ready.

Kai (EngOncall): Posting the cache + concurrency snippet here: ```
{kvcache: true, max_concurrency: 6, incremental_embeddings: true}
```

Ivy (AM): Thanks all. Marking as priority until we know whether Dedicated pilot is needed. :)

Nina (CSM): Will update once customer confirms team start dates.
